english.title: Drive motor vehicle on a road with child passenger aged 3 to 13 years sat in rear and not wearing a seat belt
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse, drove a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), which was fitted with a rear seat belt, on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), whilst carrying in the rear of the vehicle a child of or over the age of 3 years but under the age of 14 years who was not wearing a seat belt in conformity with The Motor Vehicles (Wearing of Seat Belts) Regulations 1993, namely **(..SPECIFY THE FAILURE TO USE A BOOSTER SEAT / CUSHION / WEAR ADULT BELT..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 15(3)(b) and (4) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) See regulation 3 for meaning of "relevant vehicle".
(ii) See regulation 8 for meaning of seat belt to be worn.
(iii) This offence only applies for persons of or over the age of 3 and under the age of 14 years.
(iv) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see below for wording.
(v) Fixed penalty scheme may be applied.
(vi) Children aged 3 years and under 12 years MUST use the correct child seat / booster seat / booster cushion when travelling in cars or goods vehicles until they reach 135 cms (4' 5"). There are few exceptions. Taller children and all those aged 12 years and over need to use adult belts.
